## What changed?

Describe the problem and the change made to solve it.

## Why?

Explain why this belongs in Software Release Radar and any user-facing behaviour that changes.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
- [ ] I ran `docker compose config` for Compose changes.
- [ ] I built the Docker image for container or dependency changes.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when behaviour changed.
- [ ] I checked that documentation still matches the implementation.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] I did not commit secrets, tokens, passwords, SSH keys, databases or backups.
- [ ] I did not include private hostnames, internal IP addresses or identifiable infrastructure screenshots.
- [ ] New outbound network access or credentials are documented.
- [ ] State-changing web routes retain CSRF protection.

## AI-assisted work

AI-assisted contributions are welcome. If AI tooling was used, the contributor remains responsible for understanding and reviewing the submitted change.
